findings.finding: v2 verifies the frozen dependency closure before controller dispatch and before the worker loader, but does not repeat the full exact double-read closure after the sealed scientific process returns, after scientific validation, around isolated result and ACK publication, before ledger acceptance, before publication, or after publication; review-to-use drift can therefore cross an acceptance or publication boundary without an honest stage-specific classification.

v2 counts solver calls from termination_condition alone and does not bind termination_condition to the exact solver_status and applicability semantics accepted by the sealed recovery contract; forged, unknown, missing, or mismatched status evidence can be counted as an actual solve.

v2 zero-solver orchestration accepts caller-supplied scientific validator and publisher callables, so the test does not prove integration with the exact sealed recovery validator, AcceptedEvidence/ControllerLedger/builders, and v7 publication/reconciliation primitives used by production.
